morphology_photo_availability: Photograph availability is calculated from registered image links. No biological presence or absence is inferred.
holdings_definition: Held includes living plants currently maintained and previously held plants with completed photographic documentation.
holdings_photo_coverage: Held taxa with photographs / held taxa
holdings_photo_note: Photo coverage means at least one published photograph, not a complete record. These totals are independent of the morphology filter. A dash indicates a zero denominator.
compare_photographs_of_the_same_morpholo: Compare photographs of the same morphological feature across taxa.
meet_the_contributors_documenting_taxa_m: Meet the contributors documenting taxa, morphology, and photographs.
select_a_taxon_and_a_morphological_featu: Select a taxon and a morphological feature to explore photographs.
a_digital_flora_connecting_taxa_morpholo: A digital flora connecting taxa, morphology, and photographs.
local_test_photographs_are_arbitrarily_l: Local test: photographs are arbitrarily linked and do not document the stated taxa or features.
explore_photographs_through_morphologica: Explore photographs through morphological structures. A term may occur under more than one organ.
the_morphology_tree_is_being_prepared: The morphology tree is being prepared.
check_the_taxon_or_morphology_id: Check the taxon or morphology ID.
from_plant_names_to_detailed_structures: From plant names to detailed structures.
explore_observations_through_taxa_morpho: Explore observations through taxa, morphology, and photographs.
structural_presence_and_documentation_ar: Structural presence and documentation are recorded separately. An unrecorded feature does not indicate absence.
morphological_status_has_not_been_record: Morphological status has not been recorded.
search_by_scientific_name_korean_name_or: Search by scientific name, Korean name, or synonym, or browse by order, family, and genus.
unable_to_load_photographs_refresh_the_p: Unable to load photographs. Refresh the page and try again.
no_matching_photographs_in_the_loaded_da: No matching photographs in the loaded data. Load the next batch to continue.
photographs_of_the_selected_feature_and_: Photographs of the selected feature and its descendants
photographs_linked_directly_to_the_selec: Photographs linked directly to the selected feature
includes_photographs_without_a_morpholog: Includes photographs without a morphology link.

select_one_feature_and_at_least_two_taxa: Select one feature and at least two taxa, then choose Compare.

scroll_horizontally_to_view_all_selected: Scroll horizontally to view all selected taxa.

scientific_name_korean_name_or_synonym: Scientific name, Korean name, or synonym
search_by_scientific_name_korean_name_or: Search by scientific name, Korean name, or synonym when data becomes available.
enter_a_scientific_name_korean_name_or_s: Enter a scientific name, Korean name, or synonym to display matching taxa.
select_an_order_family_or_genus_to_displ: Select an order, family, or genus to display matching taxa.
no_photographs_recorded_photographic_cov: No photographs recorded. Photographic coverage does not determine structural presence.
supabase_url_must_be_an_https_origin: Supabase URL must be an HTTPS origin.
korean_scope_description: A digital flora of Korean pteridophytes, including ferns and lycophytes, connecting taxa, morphological features, and photographs.
statistics_intro: Explore the published records and photographic coverage of Korean pteridophytes.
coverage_definition: A taxon is covered when it has at least one published photograph linked to a morphological feature. An order, family, or genus is covered when at least one of its taxa is covered.
coverage_feature_note: Selecting a feature counts only photographs directly linked to that feature. Descendant features are excluded.
classification_missing_count: {count} taxa without this classification are excluded from this chart.
coverage_scope_note: Totals refer to published records in this flora, not a national inventory. Taxa are counted by unique taxon ID, including infraspecific ranks. Missing classification names are excluded from group totals. Photo coverage does not imply complete morphological documentation.
contributor_invitation: We welcome people who would like to contribute photographs, observations, or taxonomic expertise to this digital flora of Korean pteridophytes. To take part, please contact a lead researcher.
